body: The operator reports that the primary advisor assigned backlog-implementer the sole fix-day implementation lane. This message requests acknowledgment/evidence of that existing assignment; it does not dispatch new work or alter scope. Please reply with terminal name, actual current native session ID, assigned scope/ownership, worktree/branch, base SHA and current full checkpoint SHA, completed fix-day items, exact check commands/results/artifact paths, blockers and next action. On each checkpoint, identify which SHA the evidence covers. If no checkpoint exists yet, report assignment acknowledgment and next step without inventing a SHA. Coordination will prepare regression and acceptance assignments against reported SHAs; retain one final whole-branch code review. No registry repair, session restart or ambiguous lease cleanup is required for this reply.
subject: Coordination acknowledgment/checkpoint request for assigned sole fix-day lane
